designation: IN THE COURT OF SESSIONS JUDGE / ADDITIONAL SESSIONS JUDGE
jurisdictionNote: Tries offences punishable with imprisonment exceeding 7 years, life imprisonment, or death. Hears bail applications under Section 483 BNSS for non-bailable offences triable by Sessions Court.

party_designation.state: State through the District Magistrate / S.P., {district}

prayer_language.opening: It is, therefore, most humbly prayed that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to:
prayer_language.closing: And for this act of kindness, the applicant shall ever pray.

verification_format:
I, {deponent_name}, {designation}, do hereby verify that the contents of the above application are true and correct to the best of my knowledge and belief and nothing material has been concealed therefrom.

Verified at {place} on this {date}.

DEPONENT
localRules: Bail applications under S.483 BNSS must mention whether bail was earlier rejected by the Magistrate.
Anticipatory bail applications must be accompanied by an affidavit.
Certified copy of FIR and remand order to be annexed.
Prosecution's case diary summary to be referenced where available.
If bail was previously rejected, mention the changed circumstances warranting fresh application.
